Skill Android/NoSql
 Location Southlake, TX
 Total Experience 3 yrs.
 Max Salary Not Mentioned
 Employment Type Contract Jobs (Temp/Consulting)
 Job Duration 12 months
 Domain Any
 Description
 OPT and EAD can apply 
 

 Android Mobile Application Developer, responsible for developing next generation Entertainment / Account Managing App on Android platform . 
 

 REQUIRED SKILLS: 
 • BS in IT/Computer related degree 
 • Software development experience with 2+ years of experience developing mobile applications (including Web site, services & XML/JSON/REST and databases)
 • Solid knowledge of the mobile industry. Intimate knowledge of the Android devices, platforms and application marketplaces. 
 • Passion for great application architecture and user-experience. 
 • General understanding of the mobile industry, mobile networking, and cloud/content services. 
 Desired/Preferred Qualifications (In addition to the Required Qualifications): 
 • Experience in Android (Java / Android SDK) 
 • 2+ years of experience with RDBMS (SQL Server or Oracle) or NoSQL (MongoDB, CassandraDB, etc.) 
 • Experience with the Android/Material Design Principles. 
 • Experience with Git, Jira, and Jenkins tools. 
 • Experience with ORM, ActiveAndroid is a plus. 
 • Knowledge and previous experience/analysis of telecommunications & entertainment products & services, business processes, and back-office systems is desired. 
 Having published one or more applications to the Google Play (Android App) Store and/or Amazon App Store is a plus 
 

 DESIRED SKILLS: 
 Experience in Dev OPs, open source, Cloud Technologies.


 Multiple Openings
